D1_P1_robust_meter_local_time_slot_resid.score: absolute((sum available phase currents - April meter-slot median) / robust MAD scale)

D2_P2_causal_ewma_cusum_persistence.score: max(EWMA, decayed CUSUM) of same-sample robust residual innovation; state updates after score

D3_P3_phase_pattern.not_applicable: rows without all three observed phase currents
D3_P3_phase_pattern.score: maximum absolute robust deviation of i1/i2/i3 current shares from April meter-slot baseline

input_boundary: raw i1/i2/i3 only; no H1, context, asset, scenario, prior score, or outcome input
